closed_forms.soft_threshold_solution: f* = a - lambda/2 for a > lambda/2, else 0
closed_forms.shrinkage_bias: lambda/2, independent of the true magnitude a

variant_behaviour_above_threshold.ReLU+L1: biased low by lambda/2 at every magnitude
variant_behaviour_above_threshold.JumpReLU: unbiased; threshold is non-differentiable, trained with a straight-through estimator
variant_behaviour_above_threshold.TopK: unbiased; no penalty term, sparsity imposed by selection
variant_behaviour_above_threshold.Gated: unbiased; L1 applies to the detection path only
